newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state sells 48 pct of Nile Ginning.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state sells 48 pct of Nile Ginning.

text.p: The Egyptian state sold 2.896 million shares, or more than 48 percent, of Nile Cotton Ginning to strategic investors on Thursday, the Capital Market Authority said in a statement.

It said the auction raised 128.035 million pounds ($37.64 million), an average of about 44.21 pounds a share. The minimum price was 42.00 and the 78 successful bids, all for at least 10,000 shares, ranged from 42.50 to 60.00 pounds.
The state's Holding Company for Cotton and International Trading had offered at least 1.2 million of the six million shares in the company.
Nile Cotton Ginning almost doubled net after-tax profits for the 1995/6 financial year to 14.089 million pounds ($4.14 million) from 7.187 million in the previous year.
The average sale price gives a P/E ratio of about 19, higher than average for the Cairo market.
